newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom share price due Nov 17.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom share price due Nov 17.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG said on Monday it would hold a news conference on November 17 at 1000 GMT to announce the share price put of its initial public offering.
Telekom management board chairman Ron Sommer and finance chief Joachim Kroeske will be present and will also provide details about the proportional allotment of shares.
The company also said there would be a news conference at 0900 GMT on Monday, November 18, ahead of floor trade at the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, when Telekom shares begin trading.
Shares will begin trading in New York later in the day and in Tokyo a day later.
Sommer, Kroeske, German Finance Minister Theo Waigel and Post and Telecommunications Minister Wolfgang Boetsch will attend the news conference on November 18.
